**Docket is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes), $59, or $29.50 at the Black Friday price until 30 November, to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *A key in the Claude Desktop extension can no longer disturb the Docket app's activation.* If a different key was typed into the
  extension's settings, for example one with a typo, checking it could overwrite the record of the app's own activation on the same
  computer, so the app looked unactivated. A key given in a setting now keeps a record of its own and leaves the app's alone.
- *An activation that was disturbed this way is repaired by itself.* If it already happened, Docket now asks the licence server
  whether the activation on record belongs to your key, and if it does, takes it back without using another of your activations.
- *A refused saved licence says so.* When the extension's key is left empty and the licence saved by the Docket app on the computer is
  not accepted, the free result now says it was the saved licence, with your receipt and support@docketseo.app to check it.

99 checks across 13 areas.
